decisions.reason: As a recent door lever handle family in the firm’s core range, it still has option value and no clear negative signal has yet resolved uncertainty enough to justify withdrawal.

The mitred door lever handle family fits the design-led architectural portfolio, and despite some overlap risk with other handle lines, a one-year-old launch is usually kept while market acceptance becomes clearer.
Its multifunctional character matches the firm’s barrier-free and coordinated system positioning, so management would likely retain it while its commercial potential is still unfolding.

This more generic door lever handle faces the highest portfolio-rationalization risk among the handle launches, but absent evidence of poor reception the option value still outweighs immediate removal.
A dedicated page and a 2023 German Design Award are strong positive signals that reduce uncertainty and support continued investment in this collection.
A new finish is relatively inexpensive to carry, enhances the premium architectural offer, and is therefore likely to be maintained unless demand quickly proves weak.
